size.label: Card sizes
size.note: How the cards share the row on a wide screen. On a phone they stack, one under another, whichever you pick.

feature.label: One large, two small
feature.note: The first card large on the left and the next two stacked beside it. Drawn for three cards. The default.

even.label: All the same size
even.note: Every card the same size, three to a row. For three cards of equal weight, or for six.

words.label: Where the words sit
words.note: Where the words go on each card.

below.label: Under the photograph
below.note: The words on the page under each photograph; nothing covers the picture. The default.

over.label: On the photograph
over.note: The words across the foot of each photograph, on a dark shade that keeps them readable. Suits photographs with room at the bottom.

motion.label: Movement
motion.note: Whether this section moves as the visitor reaches it. Nothing moves for a visitor who has asked their device for less motion, whichever you pick.

default.label: Still
default.note: Nothing moves. The section is simply there when the visitor reaches it, which is the default.

moving.label: Moves
moving.note: The cards ease in one after another as the visitor scrolls to them, and a card's photograph grows a little when it is pointed at. It needs the platform's behaviour library; where that is not served the section is simply still.
